name: code_reconstruction_reread
description: code_reconstruction with the edits saved to disk and the questions allowed to reread the file: the realistic Claude Code case. parse() is edited twice and each edit is written back with write_file (a simulated workspace); the probe asks for the current parse() and may read the file. Measures whether compaction still costs success when the code is on disk, and what rereading costs in tokens. Compare with code_reconstruction, where the code exists only in the conversation.
